notes: Names are INTERPRETED after discrete signature discovery.
Campaign maps are mined separately and are not mixed into these statistics.
Generated and conversion maps are not evidence.
A place may match several patterns.

patterns.subject: spawn-neighborhood
patterns.description: A deathmatch start already sits in a large sky cell with many immediate portal choices and high local 2D sight.

interpretation.label: spawn already occupies a shared outdoor hunting cell
interpretation.rationale: Recurs on BB6, BB8, BB9 (and variants on BB1/BB7). Area and peek bins vary; the stable relation is sky + zero hops + many exits + high field/sight.

counterexamples.claim_rejected: outdoor hunting-cell spawn is concealed from other starts
counterexamples.why: BB6 hunting-cell starts have spawn-pair 2D clear fraction 1.0

patterns.subject: spawn-neighborhood
patterns.description: A small sky pad with a single exit whose reachable neighborhood is still a large field.

interpretation.label: small sky porch that already belongs to a large hunting field
interpretation.rationale: BB6 has two 1-exit sky starts whose local reachable area matches the yards.

counterexamples.claim_rejected: one exit means a closet spawn
counterexamples.why: local reachable area is large; the pad is a mouth, not a sealed room

patterns.subject: spawn-neighborhood
patterns.description: Sky start whose locally reachable area is small relative to the corpus median.

interpretation.label: outdoor start in a constrained alcove rather than a hunting cell
interpretation.rationale: Separates BB6's tiny-local sky start from the large-yard starts on the same map.

patterns.subject: spawn-neighborhood
patterns.description: Covered start that still reaches the largest sky component in a few portal hops.

interpretation.label: covered spawn with a short approach into outdoor circulation
interpretation.rationale: Recurs on BB1, BB2, BB7, BB8, BB9. Distinct from indoor-only maps with hops:none.

counterexamples.claim_rejected: any covered spawn is a closet isolated from the match
counterexamples.why: hops 1–2+ still participate in the outdoor component; hops:none on BB3–BB5 is the indoor-only case

patterns.subject: spawn-neighborhood
patterns.description: Sky starts whose pairwise 2D sight to other starts is commonly clear.

interpretation.label: 2D spawn-to-spawn sight is open (not the same as 3D concealment)
interpretation.rationale: BB6 is 28/28 clear including lower-Z depression starts. The sensor ignores height, so this cannot be read as 'no concealment'.

counterexamples.claim_rejected: high 2D peek means starts are unconcealed in play
counterexamples.why: 2D rays ignore floor delta; BB6 lower-Z starts may be vertically offset from yard starts

counterexamples.claim_rejected: outdoor BloodBath starts are pairwise hidden
counterexamples.why: BB6 outdoor starts are pairwise 2D-visible; BB2 is the opposite extreme

patterns.subject: route-exposure
patterns.description: Shortest at-rest path from a start to the largest sky sector never samples cover.

interpretation.label: spawn-to-field shortest path stays under sky
interpretation.rationale: All eight BB6 routes and many BB8/BB9 routes. Also appears on BB1.

counterexamples.claim_rejected: all-sky shortest path means the map has no interiors
counterexamples.why: BB6 has 151 covered sectors and 11 holed outdoor loops; the route sensor only walks start→largest sky

patterns.subject: route-exposure
patterns.description: Shortest path samples cover first, then sky.

interpretation.label: covered approach into open circulation
interpretation.rationale: Recurs on BB2, BB7, BB8, BB9. Shade/Z bins vary; geometry alone is not a reveal.

counterexamples.why: some CS routes are flat in Z and shade; they read as a doorway, not a staged reveal

patterns.subject: route-exposure
patterns.description: Sky path interrupted by a covered sample, then sky again.

interpretation.label: outdoor circulation interrupted by a covered mass
interpretation.rationale: Appears on BB1 and BB2. Rare in the nine-map BloodBath set.

patterns.subject: local-morphology
patterns.description: Axis-aligned 4-vertex covered loop. The most common BloodBath local footprint.

interpretation.label: rectangular covered cell (too common to imply a gameplay role)
interpretation.rationale: 202 samples on all 9 BB maps. Clustering geometry, not a reusable design relation.

counterexamples.claim_rejected: a rectangle is a room type (arena, closet, hub)
counterexamples.why: the same signature appears as storage, stairs, porches, and generic interiors

patterns.subject: local-morphology
patterns.description: Non-rectangular covered loop with 9+ vertices and loose AABB fill.

interpretation.label: irregular covered footprint as Blood's indoor architectural grain
interpretation.rationale: Present on all 9 original BloodBath maps. Opposite of the rectangular default.

patterns.subject: local-morphology
patterns.description: High-vertex covered loop with chamfer-like corners.

interpretation.label: chamfered irregular indoor mass
interpretation.rationale: Eight of nine BloodBath maps. A local wall-chain motif, not a named room.

patterns.subject: local-morphology
patterns.description: Covered loop containing a segmented-arc / curved-chain candidate.

interpretation.label: segmented curve as a local masonry motif
interpretation.rationale: Six BloodBath maps. Distinct from chamfers and from pure rectangles.

patterns.subject: local-morphology
patterns.description: Sky sector whose outer loop contains one or more holes.

interpretation.label: outdoor host with carved building masses
interpretation.rationale: BB6 has multiple holed sky loops; this is the footprint relation behind twin fortresses, not 'octagon'.

patterns.subject: vertical-transition
patterns.description: Walkable rest transition of about a storey within the same sky/cover class into a larger cell.

interpretation.label: storey-scale height change into a larger same-cover cell
interpretation.rationale: The single most common vertical signature on all 9 BB maps. Too frequent to mean 'overlook'.

counterexamples.claim_rejected: a storey delta is an overlook / sniper balcony
counterexamples.why: most samples are ordinary stairs or floor splits with no visibility or resource context

patterns.subject: vertical-transition
patterns.description: Walkable transition from a sky sector into a covered sector.

interpretation.label: leaving outdoor circulation into a covered mass
interpretation.rationale: Rarer than same-sky steps. BB1, BB6, BB7. Often a descent on BB6.

patterns.subject: vertical-transition
patterns.description: Walkable transition from cover into sky.

interpretation.label: emerging from a covered mass into outdoor circulation
interpretation.rationale: The reverse of open-into-cover. Needs route/resource context before calling it a reveal.

patterns.subject: route-exposure
patterns.description: Campaign start-to-sky shortest path samples cover first, then sky.

interpretation.label: single-player start typically approaches outdoor space from cover
interpretation.rationale: Dominant unsigned campaign route family (many E* maps). Not mixed with BloodBath statistics; BB6 is the opposite (all-sky shortest paths).

counterexamples.claim_rejected: Blood maps generally spawn into outdoor hunting space
counterexamples.why: original campaign routes are mostly CS; original BloodBath BB6 is all-sky

patterns.subject: local-morphology
patterns.description: Axis-aligned 4-vertex covered loop. The modal campaign footprint.

interpretation.label: rectangular covered cell (campaign construction default)
interpretation.rationale: 3495 samples on 42 campaign maps. Same signature as BloodBath; still not a room role.

patterns.subject: local-morphology
patterns.description: Non-rectangular covered 9+ vertex loops with loose AABB fill in campaign maps.

interpretation.label: irregular covered footprint in original campaign architecture
interpretation.rationale: Same relation as BloodBath, independently counted on E* maps.

patterns.subject: vertical-transition
patterns.description: Campaign storey-scale rest transitions within the same sky/cover class into a larger cell.

interpretation.label: storey height change into a larger same-cover cell (campaign)
interpretation.rationale: Very common; still insufficient for 'overlook' without visibility/resource context.
